I'm modding my first sub and someone posted on it advertising their own sub. how do other mods deal with this kind of thing. Do you just delete the post, or do you think its ok? The other sub is semi related since it's in the same genera.
When should we allow and disallow spam

It's really up to you, but I would consider how it would be viewed by your sub's audience. If it's something that's generally frowned upon, delete it. Ideally, your sub should have a formal rule in place regarding advertising other subverses to ensure that there is no gray area should you choose to remove an ad.

That being said, as Voat is still new, you may want to consider allowing it for the time being. It's a nice thing to do :)

This - always try to find a reason to allow it.

IMHO a cornerstone of reddit's problem was that they were more interested in keeping readers happy and had no problems pissing off contributors. This gave the authoritarian mods the green light to look for reasons to delete things, which made them feel powerful.

We should focus on contributors - make people want to contribute stuff, and the readers will be there. You don't have to be silly about it, of course - Viagra ads still get trashed (unless you're modding /v/ErectileDysfunction ), but in general if you're on the fence, I'd say leave it to the uppy/downy voats.

I'd allow it, since it's for another subverse. If you don't want to do that, you could always add a note in the sidebar, saying to ask you first.

Better yet, you could poll your community and get some feedback. See what your users think of those kinds of posts. If they're in favor of them, let them stay. If the community doesn't like them, you could consider removing them in the future.

Zeb b. 2012-06-02 d. 2015-07-12 I love you and will miss you terribly my little buddy.

Zeb was a vocal, happy, affectionate, loyal, brave and loving little buddy. I got him with his brother Kai from a feral kitten rescue organization. It took him a while to warm up but he became very attached to his family. He loved to crawl under the covers in the morning for a cuddle. He loved playing "chase the cookie' where I threw treats in random directions for him and his brother Kai to chase. He adored going outside and would caterwaul incessantly after breakfast until I let him out. Our street has a low speed limit so I thought he would be OK outside. He was killed this morning by a hit and run driver without the decency to stop, leaving me to find him on the side of the road and wonder if he suffered long. He was only three and I thought we had at least another 15 years to love each other. He is buried in the forest he loved to wander, under a small flowering tree, with his favourite toys and cookies and the blanket he would crawl under when it got cold in wintertime.

I am devastated and just wanted to share a glimmer of the wonderful little creature I was privileged to share three years with. I still have his brother but he is already wandering he house calling for his missing sibling.

Thanks for understanding ... I'm sure many folks here understand what it is like to lose a furbaby.

I'm so sorry about your fuzzy little friend but I'm glad he got a life with someone who clearly loved him so much and put so much energy into his well-being -- presumably out of a sense of elated love and joy so that it didn't even feel like an energy expenditure.

Zeb sounds lovely and I am tossing good vibes your way. That driver is an awful fucking human being but I'm glad that at the very least Zeb's physical self gets to stay in a flourishing forest forever after.
That's heartbreaking, I'm so sorry for your loss :(

As someone who works as a foster 'parent' to kittens, first, I want to say thank you for sharing your love and experience with Zeb. Second, thank you for opening your home and heart to Zeb and Kai. I know sometimes how much time it takes to get feral and semi-feral cats to trust in a person. You are so very special and I am sure Zeb and Kai have shown you every day just how special you are.

I am so sorry for your loss. And I wish those words could help alleviate the pain. But you had this amazing gift and gave Zeb a life, love, and understanding.

Please watch over Kai for the next few weeks. He may become a bit depressed by Zeb's absence. He will be your strength and he will need yours- if he allows.

If you need to talk about anything; seriously, if you need advice or if you just need an ear, I would be honored.
